name: chelis-en-japon
description: Guía interactiva del viaje de Chelis a Japón — agosto 2026

scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.check: npm run validate:data && npm test && npm run build
